program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((div-color (find (lambda (clr)
                                     (and
                                       (for/or ((r (range 0 h)))
                                               (for/and ((cc (range 0 w)))
                                                        (= (at g r cc) clr)))
                                       (for/or ((cc (range 0 w)))
                                               (for/and ((r (range 0 h)))
                                                        (= (at g r cc) clr)))))
                                   (grid-colors g)))
                  (div-rows (for/list ((r (range 0 h)) #:when
                                (for/and ((cc (range 0 w))) (= (at g r cc) div-color)))
                              r))
                  (div-cols (for/list ((cc (range 0 w)) #:when
                                (for/and ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r cc) div-color)))
                              cc))
                  (row-bounds (append (list -1) div-rows (list h)))
                  (col-bounds (append (list -1) div-cols (list w)))
                  (row-ranges (filter (lambda (p) (<= (first p) (second p)))
                                      (let loop
                                           ((bs row-bounds))
                                           (if (null? (cdr bs))
                                               (list)
                                               (cons (list (+ (car bs) 1)
                                                           (- (cadr bs) 1))
                                                     (loop (cdr bs)))))))
                  (col-ranges (filter (lambda (p) (<= (first p) (second p)))
                                      (let loop
                                           ((bs col-bounds))
                                           (if (null? (cdr bs))
                                               (list)
                                               (cons (list (+ (car bs) 1)
                                                           (- (cadr bs) 1))
                                                     (loop (cdr bs)))))))
                  (nr (length row-ranges))
                  (nc (length col-ranges)))
             (build-grid nr
                         nc
                         (r c)
                         (let* ((rr (list-ref row-ranges r))
                                (cc (list-ref col-ranges (- (- nc 1) c)))
                                (r0 (first rr))
                                (c0 (first cc))
                                (v (at g r0 c0)))
                           (if (or (zero? v) (= v div-color)) 0 v)))))))
